defects.description: The touch barrier parse does not check what follows the number. 'Will Bitcoin reach $91k ...' becomes barrier 91.0 and '$1M' becomes 1.0, instead of returning None, which breaks the 'never guesses' rule. With a barrier far below spot, the pricer would treat the market as touched (P=1). Latent: none of the 426 live questions use a suffix, and Phase 1's market_info 'above $X' regex behaves the same way.
defects.fix_hint: Add a negative lookahead after the number in the L148 regex, e.g. r"\b(reach|dip to) \$([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)(?![\d.,]*\s*[kKmMbB]\b)", or require a space, '?' or end of string after it.

defects.description: sigma_q_for returns NaN instead of None when a close is NaN, zero or negative, or when dvol is NaN. accepts() fails closed on NaN, but a downstream pricer gets NaN rather than the documented None.
defects.fix_hint: Return None unless math.isfinite(result) and result > 0, and for DVOL require math.isfinite(r['dvol']).

defects.description: Nothing checks that the rules' Binance pair matches the slug asset. A SOL slug whose rules name BTC/USDT gives asset SOL with source_id binance:BTC/USDT, and the kernel's provenance check, which only checks membership in the strategy's sources, would not catch it. Latent: all 426 live markets match. Phase 1 market_info has the same gap.
defects.fix_hint: In market_info_ext, set src = '' when src != ASSETS[asset]['source_id'].
